The '''Yelsainians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the planet [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]].<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mishowan Shigormallan]], a [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] with the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], was a Yelsainian.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
